mapper.insert: INSERT INTO submission (task_id, student_id, file_name, file_path, submit_time, score, comment, is_locked) VALUES (#{taskId}, #{studentId}, #{fileName}, #{filePath}, #{submitTime}, #{score}, #{comment}, #{isLocked})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM submission WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND student_id = #{studentId}
mapper.update: UPDATE submission SET task_id = #{taskId}, student_id = #{studentId}, file_name = #{fileName}, file_path = #{filePath}, submit_time = #{submitTime}, score = #{score}, comment = #{comment}, is_locked = #{isLocked} WHERE id = #{id}
